probe.capture_text:
BEGIN
DEFAULT
INTERNAL CD
RES
INTERNAL CD
NORES
ALL
INTERNAL CD

observations: C:Which CD and C:Which CD RES each emit INTERNAL CD followed by LF.
C:Which CD NORES emits no line, and the following ALL marker is reached under FailAt 20.
C:Which CD ALL emits INTERNAL CD followed by LF, then the fixture stops before END under FailAt 20. This proves only an error-level result of 20 or higher for that invocation.
limits: The startup sequence and output target are authored probe content on a disposable ADF copy.
This does not establish exact return levels, IoErr, diagnostics, disabled internal behavior, other switch combinations, parsing failures, cancellation, or MorphOS behavior.
Neither the original ADF nor its C/Which bytes are copied into this repository.
